results.command: outbound encode implementation and contract tests
results.detail: Added AudioEngineModel::encode_driver_stream_packet_from_lane, which processes a caller-owned lane block through the same immutable graph / Group Master / limiter path as WASAPI output and encodes the result with the v1 SDK API (80-byte header plus interleaved Float32). Contract tests cover valid encode round-trip, invalid lane, format mismatch, zero generation, non-finite samples, and fail-closed behavior without partial packets.
